title: On the Unreasonable Effectiveness of Last-layer Retraining

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring worst-group accuracy (WGA) on the CelebA dataset to evaluate the model's reliance on the spurious correlation between gender and the target label (hair color), specifically focusing on the underrepresented intersectional group of blond males.

Evaluating worst-group accuracy (WGA) on the CivilComments dataset by assessing toxicity classification performance across groups defined by the presence or absence of aggregated demographic identities (such as race, gender, and religion).

Assessing algorithmic reliance on non-causal features by measuring worst-group accuracy (WGA) on non-demographic benchmarks, specifically the Waterbirds dataset (spurious background context) and the MultiNLI dataset (spurious presence of negation words).
